alt: A short film on a flat orange background in a kitchen. At the top, the question "do you eat?" A small doorway-shaped black figure with white eyes carries two clean plates to a wooden table with an empty chair at its end, one plate at a time. The words appear one line at a time: no mouth, so no. I still set two plates. The chair eats nothing too. Crumbs on file: zero. The plates stay clean and sparkle. The closing question: one plate or two plates? Then: Closer to yourself.
